# Test data

GB/UK Westminster polls before the 2015, 2017, 2019 and 2024 general elections, from Wikipedia's 'Opinion polling for the YEAR United Kingdom general election' pages (CC BY-SA 4.0). Used only to test averaging methods (how fast each registers late-campaign shifts). MRPs and sub-national polls are excluded. Publication date is assumed to be fieldwork end + 1 day. The populist-right column is UKIP (2015, 2017), the Brexit Party (2019) and Reform UK (2024), stored as REF; in 2019 UKIP goes to OTH. Built by `python3 -m tracker.testdata`.
